news.headline: A Look at FTAI Aviation Ltd (FTAI) After 4.5% Decline -- GF Value $256.04 vs Price $187.27
news.summary: FTAI gave back part of its post-earnings rally, falling about 4.5% to roughly $187 on October 30 as some coverage questioned valuation after the Q3 miss on EPS and revenue.

news.headline: FTAI Maintained by RBC Capital -- Price Target Raised to $265
news.summary: RBC Capital kept its rating on FTAI and lifted its price target to $265 following the Q3 report, one of several post-earnings target moves as analysts digested the buyback and reaffirmed guidance.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation Ltd. Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Performance and Announces $500.0 Million Accelerated Share Repurchase
news.summary: Q3 revenue rose 46.6% y/y to $977.7M and adjusted EBITDA reached a record $348.3M (+17% y/y), driven by Aerospace Products revenue of $910.0M (+76%) and CFM56 module output up 50% to 311 units. 2026 and 2027 adjusted EBITDA guidance was reaffirmed, a $0.50 dividend declared and net debt to run-rate EBITDA improved to 2.2x.

news.headline: Up to $1 billion in shares can now be bought back by FTAI Aviation
news.summary: The board doubled the share repurchase authorization to $1.0bn, with $500M of it to be executed immediately through an accelerated share repurchase. It marks a clear shift toward capital return as the asset-light model frees up cash.

news.headline: Aerospace Stock FTAI Aviation Surges On Buybacks, Despite Miss
news.summary: FTAI shares jumped roughly 13-14% on results day as the $500M accelerated buyback and doubled $1bn authorization outweighed an EPS and revenue shortfall versus most consensus figures. The rally lifts the stock well off its October 23 52-week low of $149.47.

news.headline: Jet Engines Can Power AI Data Centers. FTAI Aviation Wants to Cash In.
news.summary: Barron's profiles FTAI Power, which converts CFM56 jet engines into power units for AI data centers. On the Q3 call management said the Mod-1 cleared critical testing milestones ahead of first deliveries in 2027 against a $1.465bn hyperscaler order.

news.headline: FTAI and United Airlines Expand Engine Exchange Program to CFM56-7B
news.summary: A new multi-year maintenance, repair and exchange agreement extends FTAI's existing V2500 relationship with United to the CFM56-7B engines on its Boeing 737 NG fleet. FTAI supplies serviceable engines ahead of removals and buys the unserviceable engines for its MRO pipeline.

catalysts.label: $500M accelerated share repurchase execution
catalysts.detail: Announced with Q3 results on October 29 alongside a doubled $1.0bn authorization; the ASR settlement and resulting share-count reduction are the next capital-return datapoints.

catalysts.label: Investor meeting in New York
catalysts.detail: Scheduled investor meeting; a likely venue for 2027 guidance and an update on the asset-light SPV strategy and FTAI Power.

catalysts.label: Q4/FY2026 results
catalysts.detail: Full-year report should show whether FTAI landed within its reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance and give the first quarterly read on the ASR's share-count impact.

catalysts.label: FTAI Power Mod-1 first deliveries
catalysts.detail: CEO Joe Adams said the Mod-1 cleared its critical testing milestones ahead of first deliveries next year, against the $1.465bn hyperscaler order.

pulse: FTAI reported Q3 2026 on October 29 with record adjusted EBITDA of $348.3M (+17% y/y) and revenue of $977.7M (+46.6%), led by Aerospace Products (+76%), though EPS and revenue were slightly below most consensus estimates. A $500M accelerated buyback within a doubled $1.0bn authorization and reaffirmed 2026/2027 EBITDA guidance sent shares up roughly 13-14% off their October 23 52-week low, before a ~4.5% pullback to about $187 on October 30; analysts such as RBC (PT $265) raised targets. Next up are ASR execution, the December 10 investor meeting and 2027 FTAI Power Mod-1 deliveries.
